name: Co-ocurrencia de Píxeles
description: Analiza co-occurrence statistics of adjacent pixel differences para detectar overly smooth gradiente transitions characteristic of generado por IA images.
mechanism: Constructs co-occurrence matrices from horizontal and vertical pixel difference pairs. Mide entropía of these matrices to quantify the diversity of micro-transitions. AI images typically show lower entropía due to smoother, more predictable gradiente transitions.
parameters: Difference pairs: horizontal + vertical, Quantization: 8-bit, Matrix size: 256×256, Metric: joint entropía
accuracy: Moderada — 68-80%, efectiva para detectar suavidad sintética
source: Fridrich & Kodovský (2012) — Rich Models for Steganalysis of Digital Images, IEEE TIFS
useCase: Detecting synthetic micro-texture smoothness in generado por IA content

references.title: Fridrich, J. & Kodovský, J. (2012). Rich Models for Steganalysis of Digital Images. IEEE TIFS.

strengths:
• Captures micro-level pixel relationships
• Based on well-established steganálisis research
• Detecta subtle smoothness patrones
• Works a través de multiple image formats
limitations:
• Computacionalmente intensivo for large images
• May miss global structural anomalías
• Sensible a artefactos de compresión JPEG
• Reduced effectiveness on very small images
